C_verdict.baseline_n6_2S: FAILS ENG-07 v2 at full deflection: loaded worst-case 80.1 deg/s at 7.4 V (69.6 at 6.6 V, 105.9 at 8.4 V); no-load worst 90.0 deg/s at 7.4 V; per-axis at 7 deg 98.1/97.5 deg/s at 7.4 V

recommendation.tag: DESIGN (Electronics proposal; Mechanical owns the linkage)
recommendation.rail: 2S LiPo direct through the watchdog-gated TVC switch (no regulator); design point >= 7.6 V at the servo under peak load: ARM permit raised 7.8 -> 8.1 V, pack DC IR <= 15 mOhm, servo branch <= 20 mOhm (ASSUMED until measured)

structure_at_8V4_stall.note: parts are designed to 26.5 N m = centre value of the 8.4 V stall x n 6; the stall moment grows with the horn angle (n_eff = n / cos psi) and both servos can push together; the 8 deg stop case is a servo runaway into the conical stop

C_verdict.note: rate checks use the steady torque-speed line with the summed non-inertial hinge load; holding uses the weakest direction anywhere in the range; rocking uses an ASSUMED 2 deg proportional band and 2e6 N/m linkage; all to be replaced by bench data (servo torque-speed at 7.4/8.4 V, step response, stiffness)
